title: Brandon Fugal to have Marrs' sphere tested in Utah lab

tellings.quote: he told me, "I'm sorry, Ross. Brandon Fugal's agreed to fly out in his private jet to Utah where he's going to have it tested in the lab."

plain: Ross Coulthart, a journalist who covers UFOs, said on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2025 that he had hoped to see a strange sphere linked to the writer Jim Marrs, which was in Texas. Coulthart says he was told, with an apology, that a businessman named Brandon Fugal had agreed to fly it in his private jet to Utah to have it tested in a lab. The tests would matter because they could show whether the object was made by people or not.
